tools.name: p4
tools.$comment: Perforce Helix Core CLI (p4) -- the client that p4-kit's code review uses. unreal-kit also declares p4 because both plugins require the client and neither must force the other plugin's installation. Keep the check and install behavior fulfillment-identical with unreal-kit/bootstrap.json. macOS: brew cask p4. Windows: scoop main/p4. Ubuntu: install `helix-cli` from the Perforce apt repository with elevated access. This entry installs only the CLI, not P4V, p4merge, or p4admin. The check uses p4 because the binary name differs from the package and cask names.

ubuntu.command: wget -qO - https://package.perforce.com/perforce.pubkey | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/perforce.gpg > /dev/null && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/perforce.gpg] https://package.perforce.com/apt/ubuntu noble release' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/perforce.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y helix-cli
